g.text: A personal data essay built from 3,656 nights

text.style: font-size: 9.8px; font-family: 'Aptos', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Arial Unicode MS', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #96a3bd

g.text: From daily noise to a decade-long arc.

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'Aptos', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Arial Unicode MS', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #b7c2d9

g.text: 把每天的波动，重新看成一条十年的弧线。

text.style: font-size: 9.9px; font-family: 'Aptos', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Arial Unicode MS', sans-serif; fill: #96a3bd

g.text: Pattern, disruption, recovery — rebuilt in one calmer view.

text.style: font-size: 9.9px; font-family: 'Aptos', 'Segoe UI', 'Helvetica Neue', 'PingFang SC', 'Hiragino Sans GB', 'Arial Unicode MS', sans-serif; fill: #96a3bd

g.text: 规律、扰动、恢复 —— 用更安静的方式重看十年睡眠。
